mission_05: SelectKBest is a univariate feature selection method that scores each feature independently using a statistical test and selects the top K features. The f_classif scoring function uses ANOVA F-test to measure the linear relationship between each feature and the target variable. Features with higher F-scores (lower p-values) are more predictive. In this mission, you will apply SelectKBest to a 10-feature dataset, analyze the scores and p-values, and understand how statistical tests guide feature selection for classification tasks.
